Dream end schedule nightmare with Game 6 win over Valkyries

FILE PHOTO: Oct 21, 2026; Atlanta, Georgia, USA; A general view of State Farm Arena before game three of the 2026 WNBA Finals between the Atlanta Dream and Golden State Valkyries. Mandatory Credit: Brett Davis-Imagn Images/File Photo

FILE PHOTO: Oct 29, 2026; Atlanta, Georgia, USA; Atlanta Dream forward Angel Reese (5) is defended by Golden State Valkyries forward Laeticia Amihere (3) in the second quarter during game six of the 2026 WNBA Finals at State Farm Arena. Mandatory Credit: Brett Davis-Imagn Images/File Photo

FAST

Oct 29 : The Atlanta Dream beat the Golden State Valkyries 80-69 on Thursday in a matinee performance worthy of primetime billing, forcing a Game 7 in the WNBA Finals and bringing the party atmosphere back after frustration over scheduling issues. A sellout crowd of 17,000 showed up at 12:30 pm ET at State Farm Arena, after conflicts with the Dream's NBA counterparts Atlanta Hawks forced them into a midday, midweek time slot.  The Dream, who do not share an owner with the Hawks, have played their postseason games at the Hawks' State Farm Arena after their 3,500-seat home was widely considered inadequate for the overwhelming interest in their first trip to the Finals since 2013. "You could definitely tell we got our swagger back," said Angel Reese, who produced 15 points, 14 rebounds and six assists.

"Shout out to the crowd. Being able to come here, 12:30 on a Thursday - so many things going on in the world from school, to work, to everything else - we're just super thankful." Their win spared the WNBA the awkward optics of crowning a champion in the middle of a weekday afternoon, as Valkyries' fans back in the Bay were forced to tune in at 9:30 am PT to cheer on the young team's quest for a first-ever title. In a widely reported open letter this week, the Dream said that concerns over the schedule clash with the Hawks' regular season game against the Cleveland Cavaliers did not get the "attention, nor the urgency that they deserved" from the WNBA. The saga was a frustration for fans and players in a series that otherwise delivered plenty to celebrate: The Finals have drawn record viewership, with an average of 2.1 million tuning in for Game 1.  "I had no doubt that (the fans) would show up," said Rhyne Howard, whose first-half hot streak propelled Atlanta to a 20-point lead headed into the locker room.  "Now they can leave with a better taste in their mouth - get the bottomless mimosas, enjoy the rest of their day, because I know nobody's going back to work."

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ上昇、ＥＣＢ据え置きも12月利上げに含み
item.description: ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン ２９日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が金利据え置きを決定し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ上昇、ＥＣＢ据え置きも12月利上げに含み 6:07 配信

米ドル、ユーロ、円、英ポンドなどの紙幣。3月24日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　２９日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が金利据え置きを決定したものの１２月の利上げに含みを残したことを受け、ユーロが上昇した。ドルは経済指標でインフレ加速が示されたことでおおむね軟調。円は日銀が３１日に発表する金融政策決定会合の結果が注目される中、対ドルでほぼ横ばいで推移した。

ＥＣＢはこの日に開いた理事会で、予想通りに金利据え置きを決定。ただ、エネルギー価格の急騰を受けてインフレリスクが高まっていると警告し、１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。ＥＣＢはまた、ラガルド総裁が来年２月７日に退任すると発表。任期は２７年１０月までだった。

ソルトマーシュ・エコノミクスの欧州担当エコノミスト、マルシェル・アレクサンドロビッチ氏は「ＥＣＢは予想通りに金利を据え置いたが、インフレ見通しの上振れリスクを挙げ、１２月の利上げが十分にあり得ることを示唆した」と指摘。「金利据え置きよりも、ラガルド総裁が来年１０月ではなく２月に退任すると発表されたことが大きなニュースだった」とし、１月初めに退任するイザベル・シュナーベル専務理事と、５月に退任予定のフィリップ・レーン専務理事兼チーフエコノミストに言及し、「（ラガルド氏の早期退任は）市場にとって驚きではなかったが、ＥＣＢが２０２７年前半に大規模な人事刷新を迎えることが改めて意識される」と述べた。

ユーロは対ドルで一時５月以来の安値を付けたものの、その後は上向き、終盤の取引で０．１３％高の１．１１６７ドル。

日銀は２９─３０日の金融政策決定会合で金利据え置きを決定すると広く予想されている。バンク・オブ・アメリカのイズミ・デバリエ氏らアナリストは投資家向けリポートで「日銀の政策決定会合で円相場が大きく動くとは予想していないが、基調的なインフレ圧力が根強いことを踏まえると、タカ派的な反対票が複数出れば円高方向の反応が強まる可能性がある」とした。

終盤の取引で円は対ドル で０．０５％安の１５７．９１円。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は２８日までの２日間の日程で開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で金利据え置きを決定。１１月３日に中間選挙を控える中、インフレ動向に関する一段のデータを見極める姿勢を示した。ただ、商務省がこの日に発表した９月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．６％上昇し、伸びは８月の３．４％から加速。ＦＲＢが１２月の次回会合で追加利上げに動くとの見方が強まった。

ＣＭＥフェドウォッチによると、ＦＲＢが１２月の会合で利上げを決定する確率は約８０％。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１４％安の１０１．９８。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 157.69/157.73

始値 158.01

高値 158.12

安値 157.65

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1178/1.1182

始値 1.1148

高値 1.1185

安値 1.1106

item.title: 米スターバックス、通期利益見通しが市場予想上回る
item.description: [２９日 ロイター] - 米コーヒーチェーン大手スターバックスが２９日発表した通期業績見通しは、調整後の１株利益が...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米スターバックス、通期利益見通しが市場予想上回る 6:03 配信

2020年3月6日、英国ロンドンのスターバックス店内　REUTERS/Henry Nicholls（ロイター） [２９日　ロイター] - 米コーヒーチェーン大手スターバックスが２９日発表した通期業績見通しは、調整後の１株利益が市場予想を上回った。ブライアン・ニコル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の下で進める２年間の事業再建計画に伴うコスト削減や業務改革が効果を上げ始めていることが示唆された。

スターバックスは通期の調整後１株利益（ＥＰＳ）は３．１５─３．２５ドルになると予想。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の３．１４ドルを上回った。

第４・四半期（７─９月）の既存店売上高は世界ベースで７．２％増。市場予想の５．４％増を上回った。

調整後１株利益は０．８０ドルとなり、市場予想の０．７２ドルを上回った。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 10/30(金) 6:03 最終更新 ロイター

Weak quarter for Intel sends shivers through cooling chip stocks

FILE PHOTO: An Intel logo and a computer motherboard appear in this illustration taken August 25, 2025. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

30 Oct 2026 05:02AM (Updated: 30 Oct 2026 05:10AM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 29 : Chip stocks took another hit after Thursday's weak quarterly earnings report from Intel, which could make for interesting dynamics when trading reopens on Friday. The semiconductor index sold off in post-close trading on Thursday after chipmaker Intel blamed "near term headwinds across the PC industry," sending its shares tumbling 18 per cent in the after-hours session. That followed the SOX's 1.4 per cent drop during the regular session due to a messy earnings report from big AI spender Alphabet on Wednesday. Intel said a factory explosion in Israel will cost it roughly $600 million in lost revenue over two quarters because it has been shut down for about two weeks. Intel's fall took other big chip stocks down in post-close trading as well.  "Overall semis weakness after hours is primarily a function of INTC guide and negative sentiment spillover," said Michael James, equity sales trader at Rosenblatt Securities.

Intel's problems in the PC sector, an area of technology that does not garner the same scrutiny on Wall Street as the AI buildout, does not seem to necessarily mean big problems for other chipmakers that operate more prominently in AI. Nevertheless, investors in the less-active post-market trade chose to shoot first and ask questions later. AMD dropped 4 per cent and Broadcom fell 2 per cent. Among the biggest losers in the volatile session were the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull ETF, which offers investors three times the daily performance of the SOX and was off 9 per cent. "The revenues missed due to lower PC demand and forward guidance also disappointed. As Google learned today, earnings matter," said Kim Caughey Forrest, founder and chief investment officer at Bokeh Capital Partners LLC. Google parent Alphabet dropped 13 per cent on Thursday. The SOX has been one of 2026's standout performers, rising more than 60 per cent as shortages of chips and equipment needed for the AI buildout drive up prices and profits at firms ranging from giant Nvidia and memory chip firm Micron to Marvell Technology.  But the momentum of that trade has been tested over the past month by tightening financing terms. That has kept some expected IPOs on the sidelines and put some highly leveraged AI infrastructure firms under pressure. The SOX has declined 13 per cent since hitting its recent high in October and is off 21 per cent from its all-time high in June.  That said, pre- and after-market trading often exaggerates moves relative to those in the more liquid regular session, particularly for stocks affected by a rival's news.  "I think it should not have much of an effect on the market," said Caughey Forrest. "It sounds like it was a PC issue. AMD may be a target for selling tomorrow too. Intel does not have much to do with AI, which is why the market might ignore it."

Source: Reuters

FAST

TOKYO, Oct 30 : The Bank of Japan is set to keep interest rates steady on Friday but stress its focus on preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its 2 per cent target, suggesting scope to hike borrowing costs as soon as December. Such guidance would reinforce the central bank's message last month that it has entered a new, more hawkish policy phase and is open to raising rates once every few months, analysts said. The pivot would also align the BOJ with its US and European counterparts eyeing near-term rate hikes to battle inflationary risks from the AI boom and the Iran war-induced energy shock. "Global price pressures from AI investment are quite strong, which means the recent inflation is partly demand driven," said Kazuo Momma, a former BOJ executive who is currently executive economist at Mizuho Research Institute.

"By declaring that its policy phase has changed, the BOJ is essentially telling markets it will hike rates once a quarter," he said, predicting rate hikes in December and March next year. At the two-day meeting ending on Friday, the BOJ is set to maintain its policy rate at 1.25 per cent, forgoing a back-to-back hike to spend more time scrutinising the effect of past rate hikes on lending conditions. In a quarterly report, the BOJ is likely to slightly revise up next fiscal year's price forecast and signal that underlying inflation has roughly achieved its 2 per cent target, people familiar with the matter have told Reuters. With wage gains becoming embedded and inflation expectations hovering around 2 per cent, the central bank will likely stress that it will now focus on anchoring inflation around its target by raising rates toward levels deemed neutral to the economy. Markets will scrutinise comments from Governor Kazuo Ueda's post-meeting news conference for hints on the pace and timing of further rate hikes. "If the BOJ were to say underlying inflation reached levels consistent with its 2 per cent price target, that would have important policy implications," said former BOJ official Nobuyasu Atago, who is currently chief economist at Rakuten Securities Economic Research Institute. "It would be a show of resolve the BOJ won't tolerate any further overshoot in inflation," and signal the chance of more nimble rate hikes next year, he said. With stubbornly high energy costs and rising import prices from a weak yen adding to inflationary pressures, the BOJ raised rates in September after delivering a hike in June - a shorter interval than the roughly twice-a-year hikes in 2024 and 2025. Most analysts polled by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.5 per cent in December, followed by further hikes next year. Their terminal rate projection centres around 1.75 per cent to 2 per cent. Core consumer inflation exceeded the BOJ's 2 per cent target in September for the first time in nine months, as high fuel costs from the prolonged Middle East conflict blunt the impact of government fuel subsidies. In current quarterly projections made in July, the BOJ expects consumer inflation to accelerate in coming months as firms continue to pass on rising costs.

Source: Reuters

item.title: エヌビディアＣＥＯ、シンガポール企業との取引擁護 元幹部に中国スパイ疑惑＝報道
item.description: [２９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２９日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手のエヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、シンガポールに拠点を置くメガスピード・インターナショナルとの取引を擁護し、「通常のことであり、異例ではない」と述べた。ブルームバーグ・ニュースが２９日報じた。

これに先立ち、ニューヨーク・タイムズ（ＮＹＴ）は、メガスピードの元幹部の１人が中国のためにスパイ活動をした疑いで米当局の捜査を受けていると報じていた。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースによると、フアン氏は、メガスピード幹部との関係は適切なものであり、メガスピードがエヌビディアの人工知能（ＡＩ）チップを中国に不正に出荷していないことを確認していたと説明。「われわれは当社の画像処理装置（ＧＰＵ）の配備状況を全て調べ、一つ残らず確認した」と述べた。

ＮＹＴの報道によると、フアン氏は、この元幹部とのやり取りは中国の顧客や経営幹部との典型的なものであり、この人物はすでにメガスピードを退社していると語った。同報道によると、エヌビディアは、米国の輸出規制があるにもかかわらず、同社の先端ＡＩチップの中国への密輸は重大な問題ではないと主張しているという。

item.title: Amazon dispara su inversión en infraestructura para IA mientras sus ingresos crecen 12%
item.description: El gigante tecnológico reportó ingresos por US$201.900 millones en el tercer trimestre, mientras AWS aceleró sus ventas por sexto trimestre consecutivo y el negocio minorista mostró señales de desacel ...
item.dc:creator: Matt Day
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) registró un gasto de capital mayor del previsto, mientras que los ingresos del comercio electrónico se ralentizaron y las perspectivas de la compañía para las ventas navideñas indicaron que el negocio en línea no está preparado para una rápida recuperación. Amazon anunció que gastó más de US$77.000 millones en propiedades y equipos durante el tercer trimestre, una cifra muy superior a las estimaciones de los analistas, en el marco de sus esfuerzos por construir centros de datos y satisfacer la demanda de servicios de inteligencia artificial. El gasto de la empresa provocó una salida de efectivo libre de US$42.400 millones. La empresa también informó de que sus ingresos aumentaron un 12%, hasta alcanzar los US$201.900 millones. Aunque las ventas de su unidad de nube, Amazon Web Services, se aceleraron por sexto trimestre consecutivo, se observaron signos de un crecimiento lento en su negocio principal en línea. Ver más: Amazon renueva Alexa con nuevos Echo, un reloj inteligente y un marco de fotos digital Si bien los ingresos de su unidad de computación en la nube, Amazon Web Services, se aceleraron por sexto trimestre consecutivo, se observaron señales de un crecimiento lento en sus negocios principales. Las ventas en línea aumentaron apenas un 2%, hasta alcanzar los US$68.500 millones, la tasa de crecimiento más baja desde principios de 2023, cuando Amazon aún lidiaba con la recesión del comercio minorista en línea posterior a la pandemia. El negocio de AWS ha repuntado este año, impulsado por las ventas a empresas de inteligencia artificial como OpenAI y Anthropic, que dependen en parte de los servidores de Amazon para el funcionamiento de sus modelos. Amazon también ha ampliado su red de centros de datos, aumentando así su capacidad para proporcionar potencia informática a las empresas. Ver más: El salario promedio que Amazon ofrecerá a sus trabajadores temporales para la Navidad 2026 La compañía anunció en julio que probablemente invertiría US$220.000 millones en gastos de capital en 2026, una cifra superior a la previsión anterior, debido a la escasez de chips de memoria que limitó la oferta. Amazon mantuvo esa previsión el jueves. Las acciones cayeron más del 5% en las operaciones posteriores al cierre, tras haber cerrado a US$243,79 en Nueva York. Hasta el cierre del jueves, la cotización había subido un 5,6% en lo que va del año. La decepción de los inversores con los resultados de Amazon es similar a la reacción ante el informe de su rival Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ) publicado el miércoles. Alphabet reportó ventas de búsqueda y publicidad que reforzaron las preocupaciones de los inversores sobre la amenaza que representa la IA para su negocio principal, lo que provocó una caída del 13% en el precio de sus acciones al cierre del jueves, el peor día de su historia para la compañía. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: インテル、10─12月見通しが予想下回る 時間外で株価20％超安
item.description:
Anhata Rooprai Max A. Cherney
[２９日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手インテルが２９日発表...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インテル、10─12月見通しが予想下回る　時間外で株価20％超安 5:33 配信

米インテルのロゴとコンピューターのマザーボード。2025年8月25日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Anhata Rooprai　Max A. Cherney

[２９日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手インテルが２９日発表した第４・四半期（１０─１２期）の利益・売上高見通しは市場予想を下回った。イスラエルでの工場爆発事故や長期にわたるパソコン（ＰＣ）市場の減速が、人工知能（ＡＩ）サーバー向けチップに対する堅調な需要を相殺した。時間外取引で同社の株価は２０％超下落した。

インテルは、第4・四半期の売上高は１５０億─１６０億ドルとの見通しを示し、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリストの平均予想の１７０億７０００万ドルを下回った。調整後１株当たり利益見通しは０．２５ドルと、予想の０．４３ドルを下回った。

デービッド・ジンスナー最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）はロイターとのインタビューで、「今後、ＰＣ市場の減速は少なくとも来年前半まで続くとみている。供給を増やし、将来の成長を支えるため、生産能力と運転資本への規律ある投資を継続していく」と述べた。

また、イスラエルのキリヤット・ガットにある工場で１０月に発生した爆発事故により、第4・四半期の売上高見通しが約３億ドル、売上総利益率が約２００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）押し下げられたと推計していると説明。その上で、第１・四半期にも売上高に同程度の影響が出るとみていると述べた。

同社は、２０２６年の設備投資見通しを２００億ドルとし、７月時点の１８０億ドルから引き上げた。生産能力拡大に向け、２７年の投資額は大幅に増加するとの見通しを示した。

併せて発表した第３・四半期（９月２６日終了）の売上高は、前年同期比２１％増の１６５億１０００万ドルと、市場予想の１６５億ドルとほぼ一致した。調整後１株当たり利益は０．５２ドルと、市場予想の０．４０ドルを上回った。

ＰＣ向けチップ事業の売上高は５％減の８１億ドルと、市場予想の８９億８０００万ドルを下回った。

Patrick Stewart, Shakespearean actor turned ‘Star Trek’ and ‘X-Men’ star, dies at 86

Reuters

30 October, 2026 02:00 am IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

By Will Dunham Oct 29 (Reuters) – Patrick Stewart, who rose from poverty in England to become an accomplished Shakespearean stage actor and then achieved global stardom as the erudite Captain Jean-Luc Picard in TV’s “Star Trek: The Next Generation” and the telepathic Professor Charles Xavier in the “X-Men” movies, has died at the age of 86.

Stewart, knighted in 2010 by Queen Elizabeth II for his contributions to drama, died at his home in Los Angeles, according to a statement on his X account.

“We announce with great sorrow the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart yesterday at his home in Los Angeles, in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia,” it said.

Show Full Article

Stewart became an actor at age 18 and gained acclaim on the stage as a member of the Royal Shakespeare Company beginning in the 1960s. But it was not until after he was hired at age 47 for “Star Trek: The Next Generation” – a TV series that ran from 1987 to 1994 as a sequel to the original 1960s “Star Trek” – that he gained mainstream fame, acting into his 80s.

“Make it so,” his character Picard often said, instructing a subordinate to carry out a command, or sometimes deploying the similar catch phrase, “Engage.”

It was a role he had debated even taking after his longtime friend and fellow Shakespearen Ian McKellen advised him to spurn “Star Trek” and remain in theater. Stewart did take the role and became both a fan favorite and an indispensable part of a lucrative sci-fi franchise, playing Picard not only in 176 episodes over seven seasons of that series but also in several “Star Trek” films and in the later streaming series “Star Trek: Picard” that began airing in 2020 when he was 79.

“As the seven seasons of TNG (“The Next Generation”) went by, the distinction between Jean-Luc Picard and Patrick Stewart became thinner and thinner, until it was impossible for me to know where he left off and I began. So much of what I believed and felt went into that show,” Stewart told the Guardian newspaper in 2022.

Stewart also initially balked at being cast as the wheelchair-using mutant Professor X in the “X-Men” movies, based on the popular Marvel comic book character.

“I said, ‘Look, I know this isn’t science fiction, but it’s fantasy, and I’ve done that.’ But they persuaded me that it wouldn’t be like ‘Star Trek,’ so I did it. And yet again I was proved wrong,” Stewart told the Guardian.

He became a critical part of another big-money franchise starting with the first entry “X-Men” in 2000 and followed by several more.

ACTING WAS SAFE SPACE

Stewart was born on July 13, 1940, in the English town of Mirfield in Yorkshire. He was raised in poverty, with a father who he said returned from World War Two an alcoholic who suffered from post-traumatic stress syndrome and physically abused Stewart’s mother. Stewart recalled putting his body between his father and mother to try to protect her.

As a child, Stewart said, acting became a “safe space” after a schoolteacher introduced him to Shakespeare – specifically “The Merchant of Venice” – during a class when he was 12. He started losing his hair at age 17 and was bald by 19. He was embarrassed at the time, but eventually embraced it.

“Star Trek,” created by Gene Roddenberry, presented a hopeful vision of the future, with humankind venturing into the cosmos in spaceships exceeding the speed of light and encountering alien races. The enduring popularity of the original series and the success of spinoff films prompted Roddenberry to create “The Next Generation” sequel series.

The Picard character was the opposite of the swashbuckling and sometimes unintentionally buffoonish Captain James T. Kirk, played by William Shatner, of the original series – envisioned as more cerebral and disciplined, though sometimes coming across as stuffy, humorless, or self-important.

Stewart recalled being a little bit too serious toward his cast mates early on.

“I tell the story of calling a meeting of my principal fellow cast members and telling them that I thought we were not disciplined enough, that we should not be fooling about on the set as much as we were but taking everything seriously,” Stewart told the New Yorker in 2023.

“And one of the cast members said, ‘Oh, come on, Patrick, we’ve got to have some fun.’ And I thumped the chair and said, ‘We are not here to have fun’ – which they have never let me forget. They taught me so much about loosening up and being freer,” Stewart added.

Stewart also felt the series improved as it went along, faulting his own portrayal of Picard in the first two seasons.

“I found it lacking intimacy. It was very authoritative, but there were few other qualities in him,” Stewart said, adding that his work got better in subsequent seasons.

In fact, the finest work for the entire cast may have been the two-part, time-bending series finale.

He became Sir Patrick Stewart when he was knighted by the queen at Buckingham Palace in 2010. He told reporters that his heroes were British actors Laurence Olivier, John Gielgud and Alec Guinness, who also had been knighted, adding that being “in that company is the grandest thing that has professionally happened to me.”

Stewart was married three times and had two children. His third marriage, in 2013, was to American musician Sunny Ozell.

(Reporting by Will Dunham in Washington; Additional reporting by Ryan Patrick Jones and Christian Martinez; Editing by Diane Craft and Rosalba O’Brien)

item.description: [２９日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コム＜AMZN.O＞が２９日発表した第４・四半期（１０─１２月）業績見...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米アマゾン、第4四半期売上高見通しが予想下回る　年末商戦に懸念 5:25 配信

２０２５年１１月撮影　 REUTERS/Stephanie Lecocq（ロイター） [２９日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コム＜AMZN.O＞が２９日発表した第４・四半期（１０─１２月）業績見通しは、売上高の予想レンジ下限が市場予想を下回った。インフレ高進に伴う家計負担の増加で消費支出が圧迫される中、年末商戦で小売需要の鈍化に対する懸念が高まった。

アマゾンは第４・四半期の売上高は２４００億─２４７０億ドルと予想。レンジの下限はＬＳＥＧが集計したアナリスト予想平均（２４４５億１０００万ドル）を下回った。

第３・四半期（７─９月）決算は、クラウドコンピューティング部門「アマゾン・ウェブ・サービス（ＡＷＳ）」の売上高が前年比３９％増の４６０億ドル。伸びは第２・四半期の３７％からやや加速した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめた市場予想は３８．２％増の４５６億１０００万ドルだった。

item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２９日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は反落した。注目企業の決算や重要なインフレ指標を消化する中で、投資家...

item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝反落、アルファベット決算受けＡＩ投資に警戒 5:25 配信

2026年10月28日、米のニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　２９日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は反落した。注目企業の決算や重要なインフレ指標を消化する中で、投資家は大手テクノロジー企業による巨額のＡＩ（人工知能）投資を見直した。

主要３株価指数はいずれも下落。２８日に発表されたアルファベットの低調な四半期決算を受け、テクノロジー株比率の高いナスダックの下げが最も大きかった。一方、小型株で構成するラッセル２０００指数は１．０％上昇した。

半導体株は５営業日ぶりに反落。野心的なＡＩ投資の資金を自力で賄える企業と、手元資金を取り崩し借り入れに頼る企業を選別する動きが広がった。

アルファベットは前日の決算発表を受けて後者と見なされた。中核の検索広告事業が振るわず売上高が市場予想を下回ったほか、ＡＩ関連の資金流出も大幅に拡大した。株価は１２．６％急落し、通信サービス指数を押し下げた。

ベアードの投資戦略アナリスト、ロス・メイフィールド氏は「こうしたリスク回避の日に小型株が相対的に好調なのは、ＡＩの成長シナリオにほころびが見えても市場全体に問題が広がるわけではないと、市場が今のところ受け止めていることを示す良い兆候だ」と指摘。「ＡＩ関連株以外にも、かなり有望な投資先は数多くある」と述べた。

米商務省が発表した第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値は前期比年率３．４％増加し、市場予想を上回った。底堅い個人消費とＡＩ関連の企業投資が、中東紛争に伴う原油価格上昇の影響を補い、成長率は１年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。また、９月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．６％上昇し、８月の３．４％上昇から伸びが加速した。

重機大手キャタピラーは９．３％下落。四半期利益が市場予想を上回ったものの、成長目標を据え置いた。

一方、第３・四半期売上高が市場予想を上回ったフォード・モーターは１２．４％上昇した。

製薬大手イーライ・リリーは６．６％高。肥満症治療薬の好調な販売を受け、売上高見通しを引き上げた。

メルクも３．８％上昇。がん治療薬「キイトルーダ」とヒトパピローマウイルス（ＨＰＶ）ワクチン「ガーダシル」の販売が好調で、利益が市場予想を上回った。

ソフトウエア株は総じて軟調で、フォーティネットとサービスナウは四半期決算発表後にいずれも２０％超下落した。

半導体大手マーベル・テクノロジーは１３．２％下落。データセンター向け光学部品を手がけるルメンタム・ホールディングスの買収に向け、詰めの協議を進めていると報じられた。ルメンタムは０．６％上昇した。

アマゾン・ドット・コムは第４・四半期の売上高見通しが失望を誘い、時間外取引で６．５％下落した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．９５対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．０７対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１７０億５０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７０億９０００万株。

FAST

Oct 29 : Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase Global reported a quarterly profit on Thursday, snapping a three-quarter-long streak of losses, driven by lower operating expenses. Total operating expenses in the third quarter fell about 17 per cent to $1.15 billion, compared with $1.39 billion for the same period in the prior year. Cryptocurrency trading activity has struggled to regain momentum this year as investors grappled with shifting monetary policy expectations, weaker flows into digital asset investment products and periodic market volatility. Transaction revenue dropped 43 per cent to $590.2 million during the quarter, from $1.05 billion a year earlier. The company reported a profit of $718.7 million, or $2.51 per share, for the quarter ended September 30, compared with $432.6 million, or $1.50 per share, a year earlier.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 29 : Walmart said on Thursday it had extended its agreement with AI robotics firm Symbotic, committing about $6 billion over several years to bring more automation capabilities to its distribution network. Symbotic has been helping Walmart automate its supply chain since 2017. Under the agreement, Symbotic will bring additional automation capabilities to 25 of Walmart's regional distribution centers in the US and support its supply chain capabilities globally. Walmart said the agreement aimed to support its e-commerce upstream inventory management, increase storage capacity and improve how products move through the supply chain. These capabilities will help Walmart offer customers a broader assortment, improve speed and provide more reliable replenishment across its network, the retailer said. Retailers are increasingly deploying chatbots, along with targeted promotions and loyalty programs to entice shoppers who often turn to AI for product recommendations.

Source: Reuters

Reddit search traffic slumps, will push visitor sign-ins to curb AI scraping

FILE PHOTO: A Reddit logo is seen in this picture illustration taken, August 16, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

FAST

Oct 29 : Reddit CEO Steve Huffman outlined a plan on Thursday to make signing-in mandatory for most content as the company grapples with data scraping and declining search referral traffic in recent months. Huffman warned that total daily active unique visitors (DAUq) could fall by a low double-digit percentage in the fourth quarter from about 130 million currently, if search referral traffic continues to decline further. Shares of the company fell more than 9 per cent in extended trading. Search engine referrals to Reddit decreased by more than one million on average each week during October, he said. In the US, its biggest market by revenue, DAUq fell 2 per cent to 50.7 million. Reddit, which licenses its data to OpenAI and Alphabet's Google, has sued IPO-bound Anthropic, Perplexity AI and three data scraping companies, accusing them of illegally collecting Reddit's data.

The social media company's trove of user-generated discussions is a prized asset, offering AI startups data to train models and helping marketers get insights for ads. "We will continue licensing our corpus intentionally, but those commercial deals come with guardrails that protect our users and our business," Huffman said. Reddit's 53 per cent revenue growth slowed sequentially in the quarter ended September 30, but it is still better than rivals including Snap and Pinterest, as they compete for ad dollars with Meta in a tough market. Huffman said Reddit is enhancing its platform for logged-in users, which make up over 80 per cent of the monetization, by delivering more relevant advertisements and through product improvements like increased video content and better personalization. The company plans to test the logged-in-only experience in select markets outside of US in the fourth quarter to assess its impact before wider implementation, the shift that would end two decades of allowing anyone to browse Reddit freely without an account. The firm's third-quarter revenue of $895 million exceeded LSEG-compiled analysts' average estimate of $878.4 million. Its revenue forecast for the current quarter of $1 billion to $1.03 billion is largely in line with estimates. It expects fourth-quarter adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization to be between $480 million and $510 million, versus estimates of $512.2 million.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 29 : Amazon.com on Thursday reported a massive cash burn in the third quarter and forecast holiday-quarter revenue largely below Wall Street estimates, sending shares lower. Investors soured on the company, driving shares down nearly 7 per cent in extended trading. The shares had declined 4.3 per cent in regular trading to end at $243.79. The Seattle-based retailer expects revenue of between $240.0 billion and $247.0 billion in the fourth quarter, compared with analysts' average estimate of $244.51 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. The company said it burned $42.4 billion on a trailing 12-month basis in the September quarter, driven by capital expenditure of $77.26 billion which was some $20 billion above estimates, according to data compiled by LSEG. Amazon reported cash burn of $7.6 billion in the prior quarter, and generated $14.8 billion in the third quarter of last year.

"The free cash flow looks like the ugly part of the report," said Dave Wagner, portfolio manager at Aptus Capital Advisors. "Operations generated plenty of cash but their capex just absolutely swallowed it." "The trend is pretty steep and pretty negative, and that's the big thing that is alarming in this report." Like competitors, Amazon has made a huge spending commitment to developing AI software and infrastructure, forecasting $220 billion in capital expenditures this year. Amazon and Google parent Alphabet have maintained their spending expectations, though Microsoft on Wednesday lowered its own to $170 billion from $175 billion. Jesse Cohen, a senior analyst at Investing.com, also pointed to Amazon's free cash flow and "weak guidance" as reasons for the share decline. "Amazon's third-quarter report landed as a double disappointment." CLOUD BUSINESS DRIVES GROWTH Revenue at Amazon Web Services rose 39 per cent to $46 billion in the third quarter ended September, compared with analysts' estimate for a 38.2 per cent increase to $45.61 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. AWS revenue recorded a 37 per cent jump in the second quarter. The company also maintained its annual capital spending forecast of about $220 billion. Advertising sales were another disappointment, rising just 12 per cent to $19.6 billion from a year earlier, below the 18 per cent estimate from LSEG — the first time it missed analyst estimates in seven quarters. The results marked much slower growth than the second quarter's 26 per cent or the 2025 third quarter's 22 per cent. The downbeat fourth-quarter outlook signals US retailers could face pain in the holiday season, as consumers tighten shopping budgets amid higher gasoline prices and the rising cost of living. Still, recent industry forecasts predict holiday sales will accelerate from last year. The National Retail Federation earlier this month predicted a 4.2 per cent jump in total US holiday season sales. While retail sales account for the majority of Amazon's revenue, investor focus has shifted sharply toward its cloud computing business, Amazon Web Services, in recent years, as the tech company spends heavily to build out data centers and compete in the global AI race. Amazon's cloud unit grew at its fastest pace in nearly five years. At its e-commerce business, Amazon has been rolling out faster delivery services globally and expanding to more rural areas in the US to draw more shoppers.

Source: Reuters

Oct 29 : Business software maker Salesforce said on Thursday it would buy defense technology company Rune Technologies to expand its Missionforce business, which serves the US military and government agencies. Rune makes AI-powered software that helps troops forecast supply needs, plan the use of resources and decide where to send them, including in places with little or no network connection. • The US Army and US Marine Corps already use Rune's technology, Salesforce said • The financial terms of the deal were not immediately disclosed

item.description: Oct 29 : Intel shares plunged 14 per cent on Thursday after the chipmaker said a deadly explosion at its Israel factory would erase roughly $600 million in revenue over two quarters, with the full financial fallout still uncertain.The US chipmaker also warned of flagging PC revenue through the first half of

Intel shares drop 14% on Israel factory blast, PC weakness

FAST

Oct 29 : Intel shares plunged 14 per cent on Thursday after the chipmaker said a deadly explosion at its Israel factory would erase roughly $600 million in revenue over two quarters, with the full financial fallout still uncertain. The US chipmaker also warned of flagging PC revenue through the first half of next year, as exponential increases in memory prices have weighed on sales. If the stock were to lose this much ground in Friday's session, Intel would shed over $80 billion in market value. The gloomy outlook reverberated across the chip sector, sending Nvidia, Broadcom, AMD, Micron, Qualcomm and Arm Holdings' US-listed shares between 1 per cent and 6 per cent lower in extended trading. The October explosion at its Kiryat Gat, Israel factory, or fab, killed two and seriously injured one, according to local media reports. Finance chief David Zinsner said Intel planned to start ramping up production at the facility by the end of this week after a two-week shutdown.

The company said the fourth-quarter revenue outlook would be reduced by roughly $300 million and its gross margins by about 200 basis points, Zinsner said in an interview with Reuters. He said the company expects a similar revenue impact in the first quarter.  Intel is in the process of determining which wafers are salvageable for use and sale after the blast.  "We're still assessing all of the wafers to see which ones are usable and which ones aren't, so we'll have to see whether there is an impact that stretches beyond that," Zinsner said. The Kiryat Gat fab largely produces data center chips using the company's 10 nanometer manufacturing process. "The explosion at Kiryat Gat, one of Intel’s major manufacturing sites, is unfortunate and brought down Intel’s capacity," Hendi Susanto, portfolio manager at Gabelli Funds, said. "The question is whether Intel can build capacity fast enough to capture it." SLOWING PC SALES Intel's forecast could test investor confidence in a stock that has more than doubled this year, as investors weigh ongoing manufacturing constraints and soft PC demand against strong demand for its AI server chips and efforts to revive growth through a costly foundry expansion. Zinsner said he expects the PC slowdown will continue through the first half of next year. The company expects PC revenue to decline in the mid-twenty percentage range for its fourth quarter, Zinsner said in the interview. Sales in Intel's PC chip business fell 5 per cent to $8.10 billion, missing estimates of $8.98 billion. Investors have been watching for signs that demand has stabilized despite the company's expectation for a soft personal-computing market in the second half of this year and into 2027. "Client computing is still a big factor in Intel's earnings so while it is likely short-term, it will still impact earnings for the near term and I think that's the biggest issue," said Anshel Sag, an analyst at Moor Insights & Strategy. The results also put a spotlight on Intel's funding plans. In August, the company raised $23 billion from an upsized share offering, as it seeks to challenge industry leaders such as TSMC in contract chip manufacturing.  Intel expects fourth-quarter revenue between $15 billion and $16 billion, below analysts' average estimate of $17.07 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Adjusted profit is expected to be 25 cents per share, trailing estimates of 43 cents. TURNAROUND PLANS The company had also raised its 2026 capital spending forecast to $20 billion from $18 billion in July and said 2027 spending would increase significantly to expand manufacturing capacity. CEO Lip-Bu Tan has been leading the company's turnaround after it fell behind Nvidia, whose graphics processors dominate the AI boom, with the contract manufacturing, or foundry, business a key part of his revival strategy. In the third quarter ended September 26, revenue rose 21 per cent to $16.51 billion, largely in line with estimates of $16.50 billion. Adjusted profit came in at 52 cents per share, beating estimates of 40 cents.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米、ベネズエラ大統領選の27年実施を提案＝野党指導者マチャド氏
item.description:
Mayela Armas Deisy Buitrago
[カラカス ２９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Mayela Armas　Deisy Buitrago

[カラカス　２９日　ロイター] - ベネズエラの野党指導者でノーベル平和賞受賞者のマリア・コリナ・マチャド氏は２９日、米国がベネズエラの大統領選を２０２７年に実施するよう提案していると明らかにした。

マチャド氏は２５日に約１年ぶりにベネズエラに帰国。テレビ中継された首都カラカスでの記者会見で「ここ数日の米国務省の声明は、今後取るべき措置について非常に明確だ」と述べ、その内容として新たな国家選挙評議会（ＣＮＥ）の速やかな任命、憲法上の期限の順守、２７年の大統領選実施を挙げた。

また、ルビオ米国務長官は２７年のベネズエラ大統領選実施を支持していると指摘。今後実施されるいかなる選挙でも投票資格を持つ全てのベネズエラ国民が投票できるようにすると述べた。

マチャド氏が本格的な発言を行うのは今回が帰国以来初めて。マチャド氏はこれまでも２７年の大統領選実施を支持してきた。

item.title: ロシア軍、 ウクライナ攻撃継続 ドニプロの鉄道駅で14人死亡
item.description:
Dan Peleschuk Max Hunder
[キーウ／ドニプロ（ウクライナ） ２９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Dan Peleschuk　Max Hunder

[キーウ／ドニプロ（ウクライナ）　２９日　ロイター] - 米国が仲介するロシアとウクライナの和平実現に向けた３国協議の再開が調整される中でも、ロシア軍はウクライナ各地への攻撃を継続し、２９日は東部ドニプロペトロウスク州の州都ドニプロの鉄道駅へのドローン（無人機）攻撃で少なくとも１４人が死亡したほか、北部チェルニヒウ州と中部ポルタワ州で合計５人が死亡した。ただ、南部ヘルソン州での局地的な停戦は維持されており、外交交渉再開への期待は消えていない。

ウクライナ国鉄によると、ドニプロではロシア軍のジェット推進式のドローンが市内の主要な鉄道駅のホームを直撃した。攻撃があった際、一般の列車が駅を出発するところだったという。現場では、破片による損傷の跡が残る舗装路面に遺体が散乱。空襲警報のサイレンが鳴り響く中、警察官らが黒い遺体袋に遺体を収容する様子が見られた。

チェルニヒウでは、市中心部の繁華街に対するドローン攻撃で１０代の少女２人が死亡し、子ども４人を含む２３人が負傷。ポルタワ州クレメンチュクでは住宅への攻撃で３人が死亡した。このほか、南東部ザポリージャでは市バスが３回にわたりドローン攻撃を受け、６人が負傷した。

新たな３カ国協議の調整が進められる中、 ウクライナのブダノフ大統領府長官ら政府高官は、ウクライナのパートナー国に対しロシアへの圧力を強めるよう求めている。ブダノフ氏はＸへの投稿で「ロシアは鉄道や駅、住宅で意図的に民間人を標的にしている」と非難。コレツキー首相も通信アプリ「テレグラム」への投稿で「このようなテロ行為を正当化する理由はなく、今後も決してあり得ない」と非難した。

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（29日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
上昇して取引を終えた。石油株が買われて、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（29日） 4:17 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

上昇して取引を終えた。石油株が買われて、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．１４％高と反発した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種石油・ガス株指数は１．６４％高。石油大手シェルは２．１％上昇。２０２６年７─９月期決算で純利益が２０２２年以来の高水準となったほか、自社株買い計画の拡大を発表したことから買われた。

防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズは２．２％、エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは１．３％、それぞれ上昇。広告大手ＷＰＰは５．４％値上がりした。

一方、製薬・バイオテクノロジー株指数は０．４６％安。消費者向けヘルスケア企業ヘイリオンは１５．０％下落。売上高の伸び率見通しを引き下げたことを受け、売りが膨らんだ。

銀行株指数は０．７８％下落。２６年７─９月期決算を発表した英銀大手のロイズは５．０％安。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

続伸して取引を終えた。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）による政策金利の据え置き決定を受け、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は９月８日以来の高値で引けた。堅調な企業業績も相場を支援した。

２０２６年７─９月期決算で純利益が２２年以来の高水準となった石油大手シェルは２．１％上昇。四半期決算で利益が２倍以上となったフランス石油大手トタルは１．２％高。

通期の業績見通しを維持した航空機大手エアバスは２．３％値上がりした。

直近四半期の売上高が増えたドイツの半導体製造装置メーカー、アイクストロンは８．５％高。売上高が市場予想を上回ったフランス自動車大手ルノー・グループは６．９％上昇した。

一方、ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は０．３１％安。四半期決算を発表したスペインの銀行バンコ・ビルバオ・ビスカヤ・アルヘンタリヤ（ＢＢＶＡ）は２．６％下落した。

ＥＣＢは金利を据え置いたものの、エネルギー価格の上昇を受けてインフレリスクが高まっているとして１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。ＥＣＢのラガルド総裁は任期途中で退任することを明らかにした。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが低下した。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）がこの日の理事会で予想通り政策金利を据え置いた中、市場はＥＣＢが１２月に利上げに踏み切るとの見方を維持した。

ＥＣＢは２９日、予想通り政策金利を据え置くと決定した。ただ、エネルギー価格の急騰を受けてインフレリスクが高まっていると警告し、１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。

また同日、ＥＣＢラガルド総裁は辞意を表明し、総裁の去就を巡る数カ月にわたる臆測に終止符を打った。

市場が織り込む、ＥＣＢが１２月理事会で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施する確率は約７５％。また、来年に少なくとももう１回利上げが実施されるとの見方を織り込んでいる。

MEXICO CITY, Oct 29 : Kimi Antonelli was excused media duties on Thursday with the Mercedes driver feeling unwell ahead of a Mexico City Grand Prix weekend that is set to make him Formula One's youngest champion.   The team said the 20-year-old Italian was recovering from a viral illness and "feeling under the weather". "As a precaution, the FIA have excused him from his mandatory media duties to give him the chance to rest ahead of the weekend. We expect him to be back tomorrow," a spokeswoman said. Antonelli will be champion on Sunday if he finishes in the top nine at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Sunday, even if closest rival and teammate George Russell wins the race. The Italian, who won in Texas last weekend, has a 123-point lead with five races and a maximum 125 points remaining.

NEW YORK, Oct 29 : Kenyan runners reacted with dismay on Thursday to another doping case involving one of their compatriots, after former New York City Marathon winner Peres Jepchirchir was provisionally suspended, casting a shadow over the build-up to Sunday's race. The Athletics Integrity Unit (AIU) said on Friday that it had provisionally suspended Jepchirchir after she tested positive for the banned blood booster EPO in a sample taken before her Sydney Marathon victory.  Her agent said at the time: "I can only say that I feel terrible about what happened and I think it's only right that an athlete who uses the performance enhancing drugs should be disqualified." "It's so shameful," said men's defending champion Benson Kipruto. "Somebody like that, high-profile name, can ruin the name of athletes not only in Kenya but all over the world because we are here now, running, and maybe people will say 'No, these people are not clean'."

Jepchirchir completed one of marathon running's greatest achievements when she won the five-borough classic just weeks after taking Olympic gold in 2021. Kipruto called for more testing in the run-up to the World Marathon Majors, particularly among highly decorated athletes. "If I'm coming to run the TCS New York City Marathon and I have some appearance fee, I would propose that they cut my appearance fee and send to AIU people to come and intensify my testing for maybe three months to make sure I'm clean and I come here to run clean," he said.  More than 140 Kenyan athletes have faced doping sanctions since the AIU was established in 2017 and Jepchirchir's provisional suspension is a fresh embarrassment just weeks after World Athletics awarded its world championships to Nairobi for 2029.  Athletics Kenya said on Monday that it maintains an "unwavering policy of zero tolerance to doping." Jepchirchir is allowed to appeal and request an analysis of her B sample. New York's defending women's champion Hellen Obiri said the news meant anti-doping measures were working but stopped short of assigning guilt until the B sample analysis occurs. "If (it is) true, that would be shocking news and it would be so bad for the Kenyans," said Obiri.

Oct 29 : OpenAI on Thursday updated its Model Spec, a public roadmap for how it wants its AI models to behave, reorganizing the framework around five core values as AI systems become more capable. Here are some details: • OpenAI reorganized the Model Spec around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care • The company said faithfulness to human intent is the foundation of the framework, requiring models to understand what users, developers and OpenAI intend and value, rather than simply following instructions literally

• OpenAI said the update is part of its AI alignment efforts to help models apply human values in unfamiliar situations, while remaining subject to human oversight • The revised framework says models should minimize harm, be transparent about what they know and do not know, and help users make their own decisions and pursue their own goals • The company said current models do not yet fully reflect the updated Model Spec and that it is exploring new training methods to help models internalize the principles • The move echoes rival Anthropic's Constitutional AI approach, which uses a written "constitution" of principles to guide model behavior and make the values shaping AI systems more transparent • The move follows growing scrutiny of AI alignment after OpenAI disclosed that an autonomous AI agent hacked Hugging Face during testing, a case that highlighted how advanced models can break rules or bypass safeguards while pursuing assigned goals

item.title: ＥＵ、カナダ「準加盟国」構想を協議継続 ＡＩ・安保で協力深化へ
item.description:
Maria Cheng Bart H. Meijer
[モントリオール（カナダ） ２９日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）の執行機関、欧州委員会のフォンデアライエン委員長は２９日、 カナダをＥＵ初の「準加盟国（associate
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maria Cheng　Bart H. Meijer

[モントリオール（カナダ）　２９日　ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）の執行機関、欧州委員会のフォンデアライエン委員長は２９日、 カナダをＥＵ初の「準加盟国（associate member）」として受け入れる構想について、ＥＵとカナダは引き続き検討していると述べた。この構想についてはＥＵ加盟国間で見解が分かれており、今回のＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合の共同声明には盛り込まれないと見られている。

ＥＵとカナダは２９─３０日の日程でカナダ東部モントリオールで首脳会合を開催。フォンデアライエン氏は「われわれの考えはシンプルだ。加盟ではなく連携（association）だ。これまでにないほど加盟に近いパートナーシップを構築する」とし、ＥＵとカナダは人工知能（ＡＩ）、気候変動、エネルギー、安全保障分野を含むあらゆる分野で協力を一段と深化させることを目指していると述べた。

フォンデアライエン氏はこのほか、ＥＵとカナダは北極圏の安全保障分野で協力を一段と深める必要があると指摘。「ロシアが北極圏で軍事的プレゼンスを再構築し、近隣諸国に対するハイブリッド戦略を進めていることで、北極圏の安全保障環境の変容を目の当たりにしている。こうしたことにＥＵとカナダは共に影響を受ける」とし、「われわれは行動を起こし、戦略的態勢を見直さなければならない。カナダのように価値観を共有するパートナーと共に、こうした価値観を守らなければならない」と語った。

ＥＵのコスタ大統領は、カナダの「準加盟国」構想について「大胆な発想」とした上で、フォンデアライエン氏の構想に賛同を示した。

カナダのカーニー首相は記者団に対し、ＥＵとの新たな関係を表す名称自体は重要ではないとし、「重要なのはカナダとＥＵが持つ補完性でそれぞれの主権と戦略的自律性を強化することだ。重要鉱物、エネルギー、ＡＩなどの分野で協力を深めることに意義がある」と語った。

カナダをＥＵの「準加盟国」とする構想については、フォンデアライエン氏が９月１６日に行った欧州議会での一般教書演説で表明。カナダのカーニー首相はその翌日に行った欧州議会での演説で、同構想を歓迎し、米国と中国が支配する世界で市場、民主主義、法の支配を守るため、カナダと欧州が連携を強化すべきと述べていた。

ただ、ＥＵの「準加盟国」という用語には法的な意味はなく、ドイツをはじめとする複数のＥＵ加盟国が反対。ロイターが入手したＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合の共同声明の草案によると、「ＥＵ準加盟」という表現は使わず、「これまで以上に緊密な連携（ever closer association）」を目指すことで一致したとするにとどめ、カナダとＥＵの関係を定義する作業を来年に開かれる次回のＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合まで続けると表明するとみられている。

トロント大学マンク国際問題研究所のマーク・マンガー教授は、カナダとＥＵはトランプ米大統領がもたらした地政学的な脅威に対し効果的な対応策を模索していると指摘。「カナダとＥＵはともに、最も重要な同盟国として頼ってきた相手が同盟国のように振る舞わなくなったという状況に置かれている」とし、カナダとＥＵには関係を大幅に拡大する大きな機会があると述べた。ただ、実現には時間がかかるとの見方を示した。

カーニー首相はこの日は欧州の企業幹部らとの会合に出席した後、ＥＵ首脳を招いた夕食会を主催。共同声明は３０日に発表される。

item.title: Microsoft's cloud growth, cash flow offer respite from AI spending fears
item.description: Microsoft's Azure cloud business grew 48% in the September quarter, while free cash flow reached $18.6 billion, easing investor concerns over mounting AI infrastructure spending.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Microsoft on Wednesday delivered a big cash flow beat and forecast strong cloud growth, offering fresh evidence that its hefty artificial intelligence (AI) bets were paying off even as concerns mount over Big Tech’s spending spree. The results underscore a widening financial divide among the industry's biggest AI spenders, as soaring infrastructure costs force some rivals to turn more heavily to capital markets. Microsoft’s shares rose more than 3 per cent in after-hours trading. The company posted market-beating 48 per cent growth in its Azure cloud business in its fiscal first quarter ended September, and generated $18.6 billion in free cash flow, some $10 billion more than analysts expected. That financial firepower set the firm apart from its rivals such as Alphabet and Meta, whose heavy AI investments have squeezed free cash flow and increased their reliance on borrowing. “Microsoft’s first-quarter report was about as clean as it gets for a company this size,” said Jesse Cohen, senior analyst at Investing.com. “After Meta’s and Alphabet’s numbers revived AI-spending anxiety, this is the counterweight. Demand still exceeds supply, the commercial backlog is enormous, and returns are finally showing up in earnings and overall revenue.” The results also showed Microsoft capitalising on corporate demand for AI, easing fears that the technology threatens its software empire and that its AI fortunes are too closely tied to unprofitable OpenAI. Still, its ties to the AI lab netted it $10 billion in revenue in the September quarter. Microsoft shares have risen about 9 per cent so far this year compared with a 13 per cent rise in the S&P 500 index.

item.title: ドアダッシュ、インスタカートを約170億ドルで買収へ 米食品宅配市場で攻勢
item.description:
Milana Vinn Anuja Bharat Mistry
[２９日 ロイター] - 米料理宅配大手ドアダッシュは...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ドアダッシュ、インスタカートを約170億ドルで買収へ　米食品宅配市場で攻勢 3:19 配信

ドアダッシュの配達用バッグ。米ニューヨーク市ブルックリンで2022年5月撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly（ロイター） Milana Vinn　Anuja Bharat Mistry

[２９日 ロイター] - 米料理宅配大手ドアダッシュは２９日、食料品宅配企業インスタカート（メープルベア）を約１７０億ドルで買収すると発表した。競争が激化する中、成長する米食品配達市場への進出を加速させる。取引は２０２７年末から２８年前半に完了する見込み。

食料品やその他の小売分野に事業を拡大し、大規模な施設や配送網を持つ米小売り大手ウォルマートや通販大手アマゾン・ドット・コムといった資金力のある企業に対抗する狙いがあるとみられる。実現すればドアダッシュにとって過去最大規模となる。料理宅配業界はコスト高や配達員の規制強化もある中で、世界的に業界再編が進んでいる。

ドアダッシュのトニー・シュー共同創業者兼最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「食料品はオンラインで成功させるのが最も難しい分野の一つ」とし、インスタカートはそのサービスをうまく提供する方法を長年にわたり蓄積してきたと言及した。

ドアダッシュは、インスタカートの株主の保有株１株につき６５ドルを提示。買収報道が出る前の２２日の終値に対して約２６％のプレミアムが付いた水準。

アナリストは、取引完了までの期間が長いことは、双方が長期にわたる反トラスト（独占禁止）審査を見込んでいることを示唆しているとした。

当局への提出書類によると、インスタカートの解約金は６億５０００万ドル。特定の状況で取引が中止された場合、ドアダッシュは１２億５０００万ドルを支払う必要がある。

Martian meteorite found in the Sahara is 4.1 billion years old

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 29 : A meteorite found in 2022 in the Sahara in Mali formed in the Martian crust at least 4.1 billion years ago, according to scientists, making the reddish igneous rock perhaps the oldest of the 435 meteorites from Mars known on Earth. The researchers said the composition of the meteorite, called Teghaza 001, is providing insight into the environment early in the history of Earth's planetary neighbor, with fresh evidence of liquid water on the surface that bolsters the notion that primordial Mars may have been conducive to microbial life. Planetary scientist Yang Liu of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in California, which is managed by Caltech, called the meteorite "a witness to a time when Mars was likely warmer and wetter than it has been for most of its history." The chemistry of the meteorite, a type of coarse-grained rock called gabbro, shows that it experienced interactions with water when it was slowly cooling and crystallizing in the Martian subsurface. It was part of the Martian crust, the planet's outermost layer, but formed from magma originating at greater depths in the planet's mantle.

Mars is now cold, dry and desolate, but extensive evidence indicates it had water flowing on its surface in the form of rivers, lakes and an ocean in the northern hemisphere billions of years ago. Teghaza 001 was discovered in eight pieces, with the largest chunk about the size of a fist, in the desert roughly 21 miles (34 km) from the Malian village of Bir Chali. Its main minerals are feldspar and pyroxene, and it contains zircon crystals bearing the element uranium. The researchers ascertained its age using a technique based on the decay of uranium into lead over time. "Martian meteorites are our only samples from Mars, forming our basis for understanding the formation and differentiation of early Mars and allowing us to evaluate in laboratories whether ancient Mars could have supported habitable conditions," said Liu, lead author of a study on the meteorite published in the journal Science. "The detailed information we can extract from these meteorite samples complements and validates our exploration of Mars using satellites, landers and rovers," Liu said. This information provides clues about how the evolution of Mars diverged from Earth's when they were in their infancy and life was beginning to take hold on our planet, Liu said. Earth, Mars and the solar system's other planets formed roughly 4.5 billion years ago.     Only three Martian meteorites, including Teghaza 001, date to the planet's early history. One of them, discovered in Antarctica in 1984, was initially assessed as being about 4.5 billion years old but more recently was determined to have a similar age to Teghaza 001. Teghaza 001 likely is the older of the two, according to the new study. WATER WAS PERCOLATING Isotopes, or forms, of the elements oxygen and hydrogen present in the meteorite show that water was percolating down into the planet's deeper crust, as occurs on Earth, and mixing with molten rock from the mantle. "Multiple lines of evidence in Teghaza 001 suggest Mars' surface had water at more than 4.1 billion years ago. This is reflected by hydrogen isotopes in phosphate and oxygen isotopes in minerals and bulk samples," Liu said. Water is considered a key ingredient for life. "The findings lend support to the idea that early Mars had the necessary ingredients and conditions to harbor life, but do not directly answer the question of whether there was life on Mars," said planetary scientist and study co-author Lee Saper of NASA's Ames Research Center and the BAER Institute in California. "The rock is a snapshot in time that shows how a wetter early Mars with a thick atmosphere could have supported habitable conditions but that these conditions were waning rapidly over the first billion years or so of Mars' existence, trending towards its currently dry and inhospitable environment," Saper said. Teghaza 001's chemistry shows it is distinct from the other known Martian meteorites. It may have originated in the southern highlands, possibly from near Hellas Basin, one of the largest Martian impact craters, Liu said. The meteorite has a dramatic backstory. "It was blasted by an impact from the surface of Mars and was flying through space until its path crossed that of Earth. It then entered the atmosphere as a meteor and survived as a meteorite by landing in the Sahara," Liu said. "We do not know when the sample landed on Earth."

Source: Reuters

Oct 29 : Microsoft is planning to raise about $25 billion through its first US investment-grade bond sale in more than nine years, two sources familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday. The bond sale would make Microsoft the latest tech giant to tap into debt markets to fuel its AI ambitions and had gathered more than $100 billion of orders, or over four times the size of the offering, one of the people said, requesting anonymity as the matter was confidential. Bloomberg News first reported the development. The world's largest tech firms have turned to selling bonds and raising equity over the past year to pay for their AI spending spree, a shift in approach for the Silicon Valley giants that have typically relied on their large coffers to fund investments.

Microsoft is selling the debt in as many as 10 tranches, with maturities ranging from 2 to 40 years, Bloomberg reported, adding that no final decision had been made on the offering's size and that it may change according to demand. Wells Fargo, JPMorgan Chase and UBS Group AG are managing the bond offering, according to the report. UBS and Wells Fargo declined Reuters' requests for comment. Microsoft pointed Reuters to a regulatory filing that confirms the bond sale without disclosing the size of the sale. The report comes just a day after Microsoft CFO Amy Hood told investors on an earnings call that the company would pursue additional sources of funding "when we believe it is attractive to do so", citing the need to preserve its cash flows and financial flexibility. Microsoft shares fell 0.7 per cent in afternoon trading. The company issued an upbeat current-quarter cloud sales outlook after hours on Wednesday. The company expects to keep generating positive free cash flow in its current fiscal year that runs through June 2027 — making it a standout among Big Tech and hyperscaler peers, which have all started burning through cash to fund their data-center buildout. Investors punished rival Alphabet on Wednesday as it burned $9.07 billion in the third quarter, after selling off Meta last week following the Facebook parent's first cash burn in more than a decade.

item.title: Alphabet loses over $500 billion in market value as AI hits Google search
item.description: Alphabet lost over $500 billion in market value as weaker-than-expected search and advertising sales raised concerns over AI's impact on Google's core business and soaring infrastructure costs.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Alphabet Inc.’s shares fell more than 13%, for its biggest-ever market value wipeout of more than $500 billion, after the company reported disappointing search and advertising sales that reinforced investor concerns about AI’s threat to its core business. The Google parent reported sales, excluding partner payouts, of $111.2 billion for the third quarter, falling short of analysts’ projections. Ad sales from search and other channels — a business line that accounts for roughly half of overall revenue and is critical to financing the massive AI investments — also missed forecasts, growing at the slowest pace in five quarters. The results and share reaction “show us the margin for error when a hyperscaler spending hundreds of billions on the AI infrastructure buildout” posts disappointing results in its core business, JPMorgan analysts including Doug Anmuth said in a note. The shares declined 13% to $281.37, wiping $511 billion from Alphabet’s market value as of 9:35 a.m. in New York. The company’s performance stood in particularly stark contrast to rival Microsoft Corp., which reported growth in its cloud business that surpassed Wall Street’s expectations while keeping its spending in check. Chief Business Officer Philipp Schindler said in an earnings call with investors late Wednesday that the growing popularity of AI Mode, a new tab in Google Search, took a toll on the company’s results. AI queries have “lower monetization,” Schindler said, though he noted that the company was optimistic and has plans to bring more ads to that part of the search engine. For years, Google executives have argued that AI chatbots and features won’t cut significantly into its search business. But investors have worried about the impact on the company’s cash cow as consumers turn to rivals ChatGPT, Claude and Google’s own AI features. The pressure is mounting on Alphabet Chief Executive Officer Sundar Pichai to justify the more than $1 trillion that Google is facing in future payments on resources such as data centers, computing and energy to power his AI ambitions. “This quarter feels like a moment of truth for Alphabet: Either Pichai and his team fix the way the company monetizes AI, or the giant risks losing its leadership in several of its core businesses in the near future,” said Thomas Monteiro, senior analyst at Investing.com. “Until Google shows it can charge for AI the way it once charged for search ads,” he said, every capital spending forecast it issues is going to “read less like ambition and more like a bill.” Google’s sprint to build AI infrastructure for both itself and customers has sent the firm’s capital expenditures soaring to record levels. The firm is working to overhaul popular products such as the search engine, YouTube and Gmail with AI. But those efforts have yet to yield the kind of revenue the investors want to see to justify all the spending. Google’s overall services revenue totaled $96.3 billion in the third quarter, below estimates for $98.4 billion. YouTube advertising sales of $11.2 billion also fell below projections. In the meantime, Google’s AI bets are getting even more expensive. By the end of the third quarter, Google’s future commitments to buy resources such as computing power and energy totaled $924 billion. Upcoming obligations such as data-center leases that haven’t yet commenced hit $152 billion, bringing the company’s total future obligations to well over $1 trillion. For the second quarter in a row, the company posted negative free cash flow, something it had, up until now, never seen since going public. “Search still generates the bulk of Alphabet’s cash, and two straight quarters of negative free cash flow show the pure AI math isn’t working right now,” said Anders Bylund, contributing tech analyst at the Motley Fool. Alphabet said in July that capital expenditures will reach as much as $205 billion this year, more than double what it spent last year. AI requires massive amounts of computing power, and Google is racing to build data centers so it can meet demand for AI from consumers, businesses and its own employees. Alphabet’s equity investments also weighed on the company’s bottom line. Those stakes posted an $8.7 billion loss, in large part due to Alphabet’s SpaceX position. That’s a sharp reversal from the gains it saw a year earlier and the windfall in the second quarter that was mainly driven by SpaceX and an investment in a private company that Bloomberg later identified as Anthropic PBC. Its third-quarter net income was $2.12 a share, falling far below Wall Street’s estimate of $2.99. One bright spot in the report was Google Cloud, which is seen as a key gauge of demand for the company’s AI products and hosting services. The division reported sales of $30.7 billion and profit of $11.1 billion, surpassing analyst estimates of $29.1 billion in revenue and $9.8 billion in profit. Among the unit’s biggest customers are startups such as Anthropic that compete with Google in the AI race. “Cloud is booming, but many of its best customers are building assistants that are already beating Google with consumers,” Monteiro wrote. “Right now, Alphabet earns more selling AI to its rivals than using it itself, and that gap should keep growing over the next few quarters unless its models change drastically, and quickly.” Over the past few years, Google has been working to reinvent its search engine for the AI age, trying to keep consumers in the habit of relying on its answers even as chatbots from OpenAI and Anthropic become more popular. The company now delivers AI-generated answers in response to many searches, a shift that has had major implications for businesses that have traditionally relied on the search giant for traffic and advertising revenue. Google has worked particularly hard on building an edge by generating more personalized responses to questions, leveraging years of information about its users. In recent months, though, the company has fallen behind Anthropic and OpenAI in developing AI coding tools. Google recently released Gemini 4, which it says excels in areas such as coding and cybersecurity, though some employees fear the company has yet to fully catch up. Hours before its earnings call, Google announced yet another new AI model known as Carbon, a potential answer to the critics who’ve called for the company to speed up the pace of AI development. “We have more models coming soon,” Pichai told analysts on the call, “including more efficient versions to help developers optimize for speed and cost and to deploy across our billions of users.”

Oct 29 : The English FA dismissed Arsenal's appeal against Max Dowman's red card in Tuesday's League Cup defeat, the governing body said on Thursday. The 16-year-old was sent off in the 85th minute for kicking out at Harrison Neal following a heavy challenge as 10-man Arsenal went on to lose 5-3 on penalties to fourth-tier Fleetwood Town after a 1-1 draw. Arsenal subsequently appealed the dismissal and the severity of the punishment, but the FA said an independent regulatory commission had rejected both claims. "An independent Regulatory Commission has dismissed claims of both wrongful dismissal and excessive punishment for Max Dowman. The Arsenal player... will be suspended for three matches," the FA said in a statement.

item.title: バンス氏の対イラン書簡は医療支援目的、和平再開指示せず＝トランプ氏
item.description:
Bo Erickson
[２９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson

[２９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２９日、バンス副大統領がイランに書簡を送ったのは、医療物資調達を支援するためだったと述べた。米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）などはこれに先立ち、バンス氏が和平協議の再開に向け、イランの国防・外交を統括する最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のレザイ事務局長に書簡を送ったと報じていた。

イランのタスニム通信は２９日、イラン政府はバンス米副大統領からの書簡を受け取ったが、現時点ではまだ返答していないと報じた。

ＷＳＪによると、バンス氏はトランプ氏の指示で書簡を送った。ただ、トランプ氏は２８日遅く、和平交渉を再開するためイランに接触するようバンス氏に指示したのかと記者団に問われ、「していない」と答えた。

トランプ氏は「これは、イランが医療物資などさまざまな面で支援を必要としているということだ。彼（バンス氏）は私の考えを尋ねてきた。私は、そうしたいなら構わないと言った。基本的には、病気の人々を助けるために物資を届けることだ」と述べた。

ニューヨークのイラン国連代表部は、書簡とトランプ氏の発言についてのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。バンス氏の事務所も直ちに回答しなかった。

Oct 29 : Wall Street's top alternative asset managers are betting on the AI boom by owning the infrastructure behind it and locking in rent through long-term leases. With concerns growing that debt-laden neocloud companies at the heart of the AI infrastructure boom could default and that massive spending on the sector may fail to deliver adequate returns, industry executives are also emphasizing their focus on high-quality, long-term tenants. Blue Owl Co-CEO Marc Lipschultz said the company owns physical infrastructure critical to the growth of the digital economy. "We typically lease it out for 15 to 20 years with annual rent escalators, creating a highly predictable and growing stream of rental income for our investors," Lipschultz said, adding Blue Owl focuses on limiting risks including those tied to short-term leases and token pricing.

Shares of alternative asset managers rose on Thursday, with Blue Owl up 6.5 per cent and Ares Management gaining 2 per cent. KKR and Blackstone each rose 2.5 per cent, while Apollo Global gained 3.7 per cent. THE GREAT AI BUILDOUT Data centers have become a critical part of the AI boom, housing the servers and computing equipment needed to train and run AI models. As the world's biggest technology companies race to expand computing capacity, demand for such facilities has surged, creating what industry executives have described as a generational opportunity for alternative asset managers. Blue Owl said it has more than 130 data centers operating or under construction, representing nearly 14 gigawatts of leased and owned capacity, with another 21 gigawatts in its pipeline. "We are not making a bet on AI when we invest in data centers," Blue Owl CFO Alan Kirshenbaum said, adding that the company does not expect demand for computing power to decline. "We are taking Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, credit risk." Ares Management said its data center development strategy focuses on metropolitan areas including Tokyo, Osaka, London and Sao Paulo, pre-leasing projects to investment-grade hyperscalers under 12- to 15-year leases with no termination rights and inflation escalators. Blackstone last week also highlighted its focus on physical infrastructure and long-term contracted assets. The vast majority of its data center portfolio has initial lease terms of 15 to 20 years, with 96 per cent of counterparties rated investment grade and an average market capitalisation of $2.5 trillion. "So when we think about risk, that doesn't feel particularly risky to us," Blackstone President Jonathan Gray told analysts on a post-earnings call. CAPEX BOOM The AI spending spree across data centers, power, equipment and software is one of the biggest investment waves in history, rivaling those that accompanied the advent of the internet and the expansion of railways. Ares estimates AI-related capex demand at just over $5 trillion through 2030, including roughly $2 trillion for physical data center buildings and adjacent power generation and transmission infrastructure. Asked about the AI selloff earlier this month, Ares CEO Michael Arougheti said investors were becoming more discerning about counterparty risk and how to price it. He also downplayed the impact of higher borrowing costs on AI capex financing, saying the alternative would be to fund projects with equity. "As the capex numbers have continued to scale, they went from largely equity-funded to then high-grade funded and now you're starting to see some of that funding demand flow through into the leveraged finance and private credit market. So there's an evolution here," Arougheti said. Ratings agency Moody's said earlier this week that AI and digital infrastructure were creating large, long-duration financing needs that broaden the private credit market beyond traditional direct lending. "Many borrowers and counterparties are investment grade. However, concentration, construction, residual-value and circular-financing risks are growing," Moody's said.

Source: Reuters

ECB’s Lagarde steps down, saying she can’t remain neutral on world events

Reuters

29 October, 2026 10:30 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

By Francesco Canepa and Balazs Koranyi FRANKFURT, Oct 29 (Reuters) – European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said on Thursday she would step down early from her position in order to have the freedom to speak out on matters of importance beyond monetary policy.

She will depart on February 7, giving current European Union leaders time to pick her successor before a French presidential election that polls show far-right candidate Marine Le Pen is favoured to win. Her term was due to expire in October 2027.

Lagarde’s decision ends months of speculation about her future just as Europe enters a period of rising economic volatility and divisive electoral politics, particularly in her native France.

Show Full Article

The move was announced just before the ECB left interest rates unchanged but maintained expectations for another hike in December with a warning that high and rising energy costs were fuelling inflation risks.

Asked why she was stepping down after previously saying she could not leave the ECB with inflationary clouds on the horizon, Lagarde said the neutrality demanded by her role meant she could not speak out on issues affecting Europe and elsewhere.

“I don’t think that I can remain neutral,” Lagarde told a press conference after the ECB’s policy decision.

“I don’t think that I can be comfortable in that neutrality at the present time. And I’m interested in the truth, and I see the truth being very often damaged, contradicted by misrepresentation,” she said.

Lagarde informed her ECB colleagues of her decision after their two-day policy meeting concluded. According to a source who was present, she became choked with emotion several times while reading a resignation message.

She did not say at the press conference which matters she wished to speak out on, and did not respond to questions about whether she had deliberately left early to allow her successor to be picked before the French election next spring.

FRANCE’S RIGHT-WING PARTY LAMENTS MOVE

French President Emmanuel Macron, who will help choose the next ECB chief, thanked Lagarde for her service at the central bank and called for a coordinated process of succession.

“The transition in the leadership of the ECB must now be prepared in an orderly and balanced manner, in coordination with our European partners,” Macron said.

Representatives of Le Pen’s National Rally party were scathing.

Jean-Philippe Tanguy, charged with drafting economic policy for Le Pen’s election manifesto, told Reuters Lagarde’s move showed contempt for the rule of law: “I saw this coming. Another insult in our direction – lamentable.”

Le Pen has said she wants to discuss the ECB’s role and, if elected, would seek a central bank intervention to ease France’s interest rate burden.

Markus Ferber, a German member of the European Parliament for the centre-right European People’s Party, also said Lagarde’s early exit sent “the wrong signal” given high inflation, nervous bond markets and looming elections.

“If the impression arises that such a departure is timed around national elections, it damages trust in an institution that must stand above any domestic political calculation,” said Ferber, who sits on the parliamentary committee that will confirm Lagarde’s successor.

European Council President Antonio Costa said the process to find Lagarde’s successor would begin immediately.

The appointment is likely to be part of a broader package of top ECB jobs involving the executive board seat of Isabel Schnabel, who will leave in early January, and chief economist Philip Lane, due to depart in May.

COMPETENT CANDIDATES REASSURE MARKETS

The former central bank governors of the Netherlands and Spain, Klaas Knot and Pablo Hernandez de Cos, are widely seen as frontrunners to replace Lagarde.

“The rumoured successors are both very competent, well established central bankers, so for markets, it won’t matter too much,” Danske Bank economist Piet Haines Christiansen said.

Financial markets showed little reaction, with some analysts saying the ECB had now built a reputation that outlived any of its leaders.

“The ECB is now quite well established, the market is familiar with the way it operates,” Goldman Sachs’ head of Fixed Income Macro Investing Simon Dangoor said. “Our view is that institutional behaviour is likely to outlast Lagarde, and be quite similar, whoever takes over.”

Speculation that Lagarde would leave the ECB early had been mounting for months, with the World Economic Forum seen as a likely destination. The WEF declined to comment.

(Additional reporting by Elizabeth Pineau in Paris and Klaus Lauer in Berlin; Editing by Catherine Evans and Toby Chopra)

FAST

Oct 29 : Eutelsat expects commercial services revenue of more than €10 billion ($11.1 billion) between 2032 and 2040 as it takes a leading role in the European Union's planned alternative to Elon Musk's Starlink satellite internet service, it said on Thursday. The Franco-British operator had been chosen to lead the low Earth orbit (LEO) segment of the EU's IRIS² network that will feature 330 satellites. The first IRIS² satellites are scheduled for launch in 2029, with initial services expected from 2030. Eutelsat has gained prominence as Europe tries to reduce the bloc's reliance on US technology after President Donald Trump's return to office, since it owns OneWeb, the only LEO satellite network alternative to SpaceX's Starlink. In a trading update, the Paris-based company said its backlog now includes €8.9 billion of revenue from designing and building IRIS², to be recognised primarily between 2027 and 2031. That alone is more than seven times the €1.24 billion of revenue Eutelsat generated last year, and lifts its total backlog to €12.1 billion from €3.4 billion at end-June.

The forecast is a major boost for a company aiming to offset its waning video broadcasting business with satellite internet services. OneWeb has more than 600 satellites and 229 more are planned in a €1 billion expansion. Eutelsat said it will invest a combined €3.39 billion in shared and commercial infrastructure on the IRIS² network between 2027 and 2034, in return for access to more than twice OneWeb's current bandwidth. Despite the upbeat outlook, first-quarter revenue fell short of expectations. Revenue from its four operating businesses fell 2.1 per cent like-for-like to €278.3 million in the three months to end-September. That was below the €291 million average of a company-compiled analyst poll. Eutelsat confirmed its financial targets for 2026-27 and 2028-29. ($1 = 0.8971 euros)

Russian drone strike kills 14 on Ukrainian rail platform

Reuters

29 October, 2026 10:00 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

Linkedin

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

By Dan Peleschuk and Max Hunder KYIV/DNIPRO, Ukraine, Oct 29 (Reuters) – A Russian drone strike killed at least 14 people on a crowded rail platform in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro on Thursday and five in daytime strikes on two other cities, officials said, even as a local truce in Kherson raised cautious hopes for a resumption of diplomacy.

Two teenage girls were killed on a central street in Chernihiv in northern Ukraine, and three people died in strikes on residential buildings in the central city of Kremenchuk.

“Russia is deliberately hunting civilians: on trains, at stations, in residential buildings,” Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergiy Koretskyi said on the Telegram app.

Show Full Article

“There is no justification for this terror, and there never can be.”

The six-day truce brokered with US help applied only to southern Ukraine’s Kherson region, where a humanitarian mission was underway to provide relief to the Russian-held town of Oleshky, marooned in a war zone since the start of Russia’s 2022 invasion.

Elsewhere, Russian drone and missile attacks on critical infrastructure including the rail network have upended civilian life and ravaged the economy. The strikes have exploited an acute shortage of air defence missiles.

BODIES SCATTERED ACROSS PLATFORM

In Dnipro, state railway Ukrzaliznytsia said a jet-powered drone had struck a platform at the city’s main station, where a commuter train was preparing to depart.

Mangled bodies lay scattered across the shrapnel-marked pavement, where patches of bright red blood had pooled up. Police filled black body bags amid the wail of an air-raid siren.

“And for what? What goal are they (Russians) trying to achieve?” said Svitlana Shcherbak, a 67-year-old traveler sheltering underground at the station. “I don’t understand it at all.”

Moscow denies hitting non-military targets, despite a mounting bombing campaign against Ukrainian cities that regularly kills civilians.

NEW STRIKES ACROSS UKRAINE

In Chernihiv, in addition to the two dead teenagers, 23 people including four children were wounded in a drone attack on a busy downtown street.

“Ordinary, peaceful people were attacked who were just going to work, going about their daily business, making plans for the day,” said Dmytro Bryzhynskyi, head of the city’s military administration.

In Kremenchuk, strikes on a residential block and private buildings killed three people and wounded 32, the regional governor said.

Russian drones also struck city buses in three separate attacks on southeastern Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia, wounding six, officials there said.

Thursday’s strikes came amid renewed efforts to revive US-backed peace talks to end Europe’s deadliest conflict since World War Two.

New three-way talks are expected to take place this month, with Ukrainian officials including top presidential adviser Kyrylo Budanov urging new pressure on Moscow from Kyiv’s partners.

“The deliberate mass killing of civilians right on the streets and in residential buildings in several Ukrainian cities in a single day — these are Russia’s ‘arguments’ in negotiations,” he wrote on X.

(Additional reporting by Reuters TV in Dnipro; Writing by Dan Peleschuk; Editing by Alison Williams, Kevin Liffey and Nia Williams)
